messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran into a nasty edgecase with py SDK tool/function calling + structured output when the auth token refresh triggers a retry. Repro below, pretty small.

kevin: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro and error?

maria: repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-toolcall-auth-retry (short snippet pasted below)

maria: ```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient

@dataclass
class ItemResult:
    id: int
    name: str

async def run():
    client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('RD_KEY'))
    resp = await client.tool_call(
        model='open-llm-3',
        tool='get_item',
        input='fetch item 42',
        structured_output=ItemResult,
        stream=False,
    )
    print(resp.parsed)
```

maria: When token is expired, client does auth refresh and retries the request. Server sometimes returns a function_call payload on the 2nd attempt but the SDK parser throws: `StructuredOutputError: missing function metadata for parser` or `KeyError: function_name` in the typed parser.

kevin: can you paste the exact stacktrace?

maria: stack (trimmed):
```
File ".../redwood/sdk/parse.py", line 120, in parse_tool_call
    fname = payload['function_call']['name']
KeyError: 'function_call'
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
File ".../redwood/sdk/client.py", line 342, in _handle_response
    return self._parse_structured(resp)
File ".../redwood/sdk/client.py", line 401, in _parse_structured
    raise StructuredOutputError('missing function metadata for parser')
```

kevin: sounds like the retry flow returns a different shape before parser runs. My guess is auth middleware replays request but some response metadata (we attach function_call info in a wrapper) is not preserved across the retry boundary.

jonathan: I actually hit a similar issue when streaming tool calls + reconnects. The SDK currently attaches function metadata into an ephemeral field on the response object created before auth refresh; on retry we recreate response and forget to copy the envelope.

samira: simple workaround is to set `max_retries=0` for now or disable token auto-refresh and handle refresh externally. Not ideal for users.

maria: confirmed workaround helps, but onboarding docs currently recommend relying on client auto-refresh. This will bite customers using tool/function calling.

kevin: Proposed runtime fix: when doing an auth-refresh retry we should preserve response envelope metadata (any keys like `function_call`, `structured_schema`) across retries, or re-run the server response merge step after the final HTTP response is received.

jonathan: I sketched a patch: in auth_middleware.py on retry do `new_resp._meta.update(old_resp._meta)` before returning. Also add unit test that simulates expired token and server returning function_call only on second attempt.

maria: i created a tiny failing test in local branch: tests/test_toolcall_retry.py -> reproduces missing function_call when using AsyncClient + structured_output.

samira: I'll open a PR with the middleware copy plus test and CI. I'll also add an integration sample app that uses dataclasses and shows correct behavior.

kevin: please also add a note to the SDK changelog and docs under "Known Issues" until we ship the fix. Add a feature flag like `preserve_function_metadata=True` to guard behavior if we need to toggle.

maria: FYI the repro uses typed dataclass parsing but same root cause breaks typed NamedTuple and pydantic models. The parser assumes `function_call` exists; we should defensive-check and raise a clearer error with remediation steps.

jonathan: agreed — update parser to produce a helpful error message and include request id + hint about potential auth-retry.

samira: creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1428 (WIP). test added.

ci-bot: build queued for PR #1428 — running unit tests.

ci-bot: unit tests failed (1 unknown): test_toolcall_retry.py::test_auth_retry_preserves_metadata — KeyError reproduced.

kevin: ok that's expected. Samira, once you push middleware change rerun CI. Also add a small e2e that hits local mock server to ensure streaming + reconnect doesn't regress.

samira: will do. assigning to eng-runtime and devex to triage. tagging: @kevin @maria @jonathan

maria: thanks — big one for DX. this actually explains a support ticket we saw last week where user reported "structured outputs randomly broke after renewal".

jonathan: when PR is ready, I'll help review and loop in runtime folks for a proper fix (maybe move envelope logic into response builder so retries always go through same path).

kevin: good plan. follow-ups: 1) PR with middleware copy + tests, 2) parser improvements for clearer error, 3) docs note + sample app, 4) e2e test for streaming+retry.

maria: ping if you want the small repro script. I'll drop a link to the sample app once samira's PR lands. :thumbsup:

samira: PR updated, tests pass locally, pushing now.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #1428.

kevin: awesome — merging after editorial and changelog updates. thanks all :rocket:"
